name: editable-visual-assets
title_zh: 每个零件都能单独拖动改色的矢量图，不给你一张死图
tagline_zh: 要改一个箭头颜色就得重画整张图的痛，它替你省了：输出的是分层 SVG 和原生文本框，图标、连线、标注各自独立。
tagline_en: Stop redrawing a whole diagram to recolor one arrow. You get layered SVG with native text boxes, so icons.
desc_en: Create or revise structured, editable visual assets for ChatGPT conversations, especially when the user asks for editable SVG, layered or separable image components, PowerPoint-ready graphics, Figma-ready artwork, scientific illustrations, diagrams, icons, flowcharts, or visuals whose parts must remain independently movable, recolorable, replaceable, or editable. Prefer native text, PowerPoint-nat
why_zh: 它按「可分离」来组织产物：文字走原生文本、图形分层命名，而不是先画好再导出。所以改字不会挤歪版式。
why_en: It builds for separability from the start: native text plus named layers, not a flattened export. Retyping won't break layout.
limit_zh: 只产出可编辑的图形源文件，不负责排版成稿、不导出高清位图、不做 3D 渲染；元素一多（比如上百个节点）分层会变碎。
limit_en: Ships editable vector sources only: no final layout, no raster export, no 3D. Past ~100 elements the layers get fragmented and you'll merge them.
title_en: Editable vector assets where every part stays movable
